hints.title: Group People by Desired Size
hints.text: Collect person IDs into buckets indexed by their target group size requirement.

hints.title: Flush Bucket when Capacity Reached
hints.text: Whenever the bucket for size sz accumulates sz members, emit that group and reset the bucket.

hints.title: Collect All Emitted Groups
hints.text: Because total counts are guaranteed consistent, all elements naturally partition into full groups.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching across people repeatedly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bucket aggregation processes each person once in linear time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should cleanly chunk elements as soon as group capacity is met.
complexity.notes: Guaranteed that a valid partition always exists.
